name: Richard Tarrant
summary: Richard Edward Tarrant (August 6, 1942 – August 12, 2025) was an American businessman and politician. He was the Republican nominee for U.S. Senator from Vermont in 2006, a contest he lost to U.S. Representative Bernie Sanders. Tarrant and his wife, Deborah, lived until 2010 in Colchester, Vermont, where he ran his charitable foundation.
